title: GATA3 mediates the cardioprotective effect of hydroxysafflor yellow a against septic cardiomyopathy: insights from integrated machine learning, WGCNA, and experimental validation.
authors: Lou, Lihong; Yuan, Lin; Zeng, Chunli; Han, Yaoguo; Lu, Ming; Lei, Ming
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习与WGCNA筛选脓毒症心肌病中HSYA的靶点GATA3，但仅做细胞实验验证表达与功能，无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联薄弱。
abstract: Sepsis-induced cardiomyopathy represents a life-threatening complication arising from severe sepsis and septic shock. Hydroxysafflor yellow A (HSYA), a major quinone chalcone constituent, protects cardiac function in this disease. This study explored the detailed mechanisms of HSYA in mitigating sepsis-related cardiomyopathy. Potential targets of HSYA against sepsis-induced cardiomyopathy were identified by integrating sepsis-related genes (GSE131761), genes associated with myocardial damage (GeneCards), and potential targets of HSYA (CTD, GeneCards, SwissTargetPrediction). GO and KEGG pathway enrichment analyses were performed, and a protein-protein interaction (PPI) network was constructed. Hub genes were identified by machine learning and WGCNA. An in vitro cellular model was generated by stimulating AC16 cardiomyocytes with LPS. Cell viability and apoptosis were determined by CCK-8 assay and flow cytometry, respectively. KEGG pathway enrichment analysis revealed the potential involvement of NF-kappaB, TNF, IL-17, and MAPK signaling pathways in the protective role of HSYA against sepsis-induced cardiomyopathy. HSYA attenuated LPS-induced pro-inflammatory cytokine expression, ROS generation, and cell apoptosis in AC16 cardiomyocytes. Mechanistically, HSYA upregulated GATA3 expression in LPS-stimulated AC16 cardiomyocytes. Moreover, downregulation of GATA3 enhanced pro-inflammatory cytokine expression, ROS generation, and cell apoptosis in HSYA-treated AC16 cardiomyocytes under LPS. Our in vitro findings suggest that GATA3 may serve as a potential mediator through which HSYA attenuates LPS‑induced cardiomyocyte injury by concurrently dampening inflammation, oxidative stress, and apoptosis. GRAPHICAL ABSTRACT: This study integrated network pharmacology, machine learning algorithms, and WGCNA approaches to systematically investigate the mechanisms through which HSYA alleviates sepsis-induced myocardial damage. Using an LPS-induced AC16 cardiomyocyte cytotoxicity model, the cardioprotective effect of HSYA is validated and mechanistically linked to its regulatory action on the transcription factor GATA3. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at 10.1007/s10616-026-00974-0.
abstract_zh: 脓毒症诱导的心肌病是严重脓毒症和脓毒性休克引起的一种危及生命的并发症。羟基红花黄色素A（HSYA）是该病中一种主要的醌类查尔酮成分，可保护心脏功能。本研究探讨了HSYA减轻脓毒症相关心肌病的详细机制。通过整合脓毒症相关基因（GSE131761）、心肌损伤相关基因（GeneCards）以及HSYA的潜在靶点（CTD、GeneCards、SwissTargetPrediction），鉴定了HSYA对抗脓毒症诱导心肌病的潜在靶点。进行了GO和KEGG通路富集分析，并构建了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络。通过机器学习和WGCNA鉴定了核心基因。通过用LPS刺激AC16心肌细胞生成了体外细胞模型。分别通过CCK-8法和流式细胞术测定了细胞活力和凋亡。KEGG通路富集分析揭示了NF-kappaB、TNF、IL-17和MAPK信号通路可能参与HSYA对脓毒症诱导心肌病的保护作用。HSYA减弱了LPS诱导的AC16心肌细胞中促炎细胞因子表达、ROS生成和细胞凋亡。机制上，HSYA在LPS刺激的AC16心肌细胞中上调了GATA3表达。此外，在LPS条件下，HSYA处理的AC16心肌细胞中GATA3的下调增强了促炎细胞因子表达、ROS生成和细胞凋亡。我们的体外研究结果表明，GATA3可能作为HSYA通过同时抑制炎症、氧化应激和凋亡来减轻LPS诱导心肌细胞损伤的潜在介导因子。图形摘要：本研究整合了网络药理学、机器学习算法和WGCNA方法，系统探讨了HSYA减轻脓毒症诱导心肌损伤的机制。使用LPS诱导的AC16心肌细胞毒性模型，验证了HSYA的心脏保护作用，并将其机制与其对转录因子GATA3的调控作用相关联。补充信息：在线版本包含补充材料，可访问10.1007/s10616-026-00974-0获取。
